digest.component_or_area: LLM review operation surfaces (CLI, library, MCP)
propositions: The single-pass `rebar review` CLI verb is superseded by the multi-pass `rebar review-plan` gate (which signs attestations and enforces blocking floors) and LLM-free deterministic checks, and must be safely retired without breaking existing callers.

The old `rebar review` CLI must forward to `review-plan` while preserving its read-only, unsigned semantics by passing `--no-sign` unconditionally and rejecting unsupported `--graph` and positional `reviewer_id` arguments with exit code 2 and actionable error messages.

The public library function `rebar.llm.review_ticket` and the MCP tool `review_ticket` must remain callable but deprecated via the central deprecation registry (`src/rebar/_deprecations.py`), with three scheduled-removal rows and no double-signalling from internal harnesses.

The implementation must split `review_ticket` into a private `_review_ticket_impl()` body (called by MCP, eval harness, and diff harness without warning) and a public facade that emits a `lib` deprecation signal, so each caller site fires exactly one warning.
